prompt: A D type flip-flop changes its output Q only at a rising edge of the clock: at each rising edge Q takes the value D has at that moment, and between rising edges Q holds its value. hint: Write down Q after each rising edge, starting from its first value, and count the changes.

facts.statement: A D type flip-flop is edge-triggered: at each rising edge of the clock its output Q takes the value of the D input, and Q holds that value until the next rising edge.
